name: Academic Applications
description: Webform-based academic position application system that bundles application answers and reference PDFs into a single PDF.
project_description:
This module provides a simple Webform-based system for applying to academic programs.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Contacts academic references inviting them to a secure upload form for letters of reference. 
 Connects uploaded letters of reference to application submissions. 
 All of the powerful Webform features are supported. 
 "Bundles" application form answers and PDFs with letters of recommendation into a single PDF. 
 Contains a working example in an optional sub-module.
